purpose: Research on kidney function in heart failure.
question: How many adults with heart failure have an eGFR measurement, by age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Report per band: adults with heart failure who have an eGFR value.
